title: Personal Loans Collections Standard: Delinquency Reporting and Charge-Off Thresholds
content:
The two delinquency thresholds of Personal Loans are the same in every grade, Personal Loan Grade A through Personal Loan Grade G.

| Threshold | Every grade |
|---|---|
| Days past due at which delinquency is reported to the credit bureaus | 30 |
| Days past due at which the loan is charged off | 120 |

## Definitions

- **Delinquency reporting**: days past due at which delinquency is reported to the credit bureaus.
- **Charge-off**: days past due at which the loan is charged off.

## Reading the thresholds (hypothetical)

| Days past due | Reported to the bureaus | Charged off |
|---|---|---|
| 29 | not yet | no |
| 30 | yes | no |
| 119 | yes | no |
| 120 | yes | yes |
